recommendedTextbook.title: Islamic Religious Studies for Junior Secondary Schools Book 2
recommendedTextbook.author: M. A. Folorunsho, A. K. Makinde
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: Salah: The Five Daily Obligatory Prayers and Congregational Etiquette
subtopics: The 5 daily prayers (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha): Times and number of rak'ahs
Conditions (Shurut), pillars (Arkan), and compulsory acts of Salah
Salatul Jama'ah (congregational prayer), Salatul Jumu'ah (Friday prayer), and role of the Imam
objectives: Enumerate the specific number of rak'ahs for each of the 5 daily obligatory prayers
Perform the complete physical sequence of one full rak'ah reciting Surah Al-Fatihah
Explain the spiritual and communal virtues of joining Salatul Jama'ah in the mosque

topics.topic: Hadith Studies: The 40 Hadiths of Imam An-Nawawi
subtopics: Definition of Hadith, Sunnah, Isnad (chain of transmission), and Matn (text)
Hadith 1: 'Actions are judged by intentions' (Innamal a'malu bin-niyyat)
Hadith 2: The Hadith of Jibril explaining Islam, Iman, and Ihsan
objectives: Distinguish the Sanad from the Matn in Hadith literature
Explain why sincere pure intention (Ikhlas) is required for any deed to be accepted by Allah
Define the concepts of Islam, Iman (the 6 articles of faith), and Ihsan (excellence in worship)

topics.topic: Sirah: Early Life of Prophet Muhammad (SAW) in Makkah
subtopics: Lineage, birth in the Year of the Elephant (570 AD), and upbringing by Halimah and Abu Talib
His youthful reputation as Al-Amin (The Trustworthy) and truthful trade caravans
Marriage to Khadijah bint Khuwaylid and meditation in the cave of Hira
objectives: Trace the noble lineage of the Prophet through the Banu Hashim clan of Quraysh
Cite historical incidents in Makkah that earned him the title of 'Al-Amin' before prophethood
Identify moral lessons of fidelity, honesty, and modesty from his early youth

topics.topic: Islamic Moral Jurisprudence: Rights of Parents and Neighbors
subtopics: The Quranic command to show kindness to parents (Birrul-Walidayn, Surah Al-Isra 17:23-24)
Prohibition of showing insolence, anger, or saying 'Uff' to mother or father
Rights of neighbors in the Hadith: Muslims, non-Muslims, and peaceful neighborhood relations in Nigeria
objectives: Quote the Quranic injunction concerning respectful speech and devotion to elderly parents
Explain why mothers are accorded triple honor in authentic Hadith traditions
List 4 practical ways students can promote peaceful inter-faith harmony with neighbors
